verdict.rationale: LocalAI is an API server, so an interactive API reference is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only an OpenAI-compatible API and a built-in chat web UI, with no interactive reference or runnable API examples. Probes for OpenAPI/Swagger specs at all candidate paths returned 404, and the chat UI is an adjacent feature, not an API explorer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
